answer: Sample 10% of submissions each epoch and audit them against a held-out set. Disagreement between auditors dilutes the score instead of averaging it. Rewards vest over the next 8 epochs, so fraud found late still claws back unvested pay. A violet identity looks like a quill stroke on a basalt wall, one address among thousands until the sample hits it. Cost: 10% audit per epoch across 8 epochs, so a farm expects most copies caught before vesting completes.
